report:
Reviewed the complete unknown_work claim, both ordinary implementation associations, the separate TODO implementation entry, and the complete associated test set. Requirements are visibility of unknown work, stable operation families for supported Sage/metadata operations, unmapped keys retaining raw diagnostic ingredients when semantic projection is unavailable, and closed dependency checks rejecting unexpected fallback.

In src/inspector.rs, LiveInspectionProvider::record passes its collected events to build_dynamic_trace and stores the resulting children without filtering unknown keys. The import association now has a corresponding essential implementation association on crates/sage-host/src/trace.rs. Its QueryEnter and QueryLeaf branches retain the complete input key as TraceKey::Unmapped. query_operation extracts the operation prefix before the first parenthesis and trims it, leaving diagnostic arguments out of the family; absent parentheses retain the whole operation. ExternalMetadata similarly separates the family while preserving the original operation string as ingredient. Semantic spans preserve producer-authored operation names. attach_trace_node retains roots and nested children, unordered normalization sorts rather than discards them, and unfinished stack nodes are drained visibly. Malformed exits emit explicit unmapped recorder-error nodes. snapshot_trace deliberately normalizes raw ingredients only for its separate deterministic snapshot representation; the live Inspector uses build_dynamic_trace, preserving raw diagnostics.

Closed dependency checking is NOT implemented by these projection functions. The new, separate TODO implementation entry in service_spec.rs explicitly records that missing behavior and its prerequisite: a complete-trace/allowed-operation checking API which recursively rejects unexpected unmapped queries and metadata without filtering. This is accepted as an explicit partial implementation deferral, not an assertion of complete implementation and not a reclassification of the existing ordinary projection evidence.

The only associated test is sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_unknown_work. It contains no assertions and proves no behavior. Its TODO preserves deferred real-trace evidence covering all balanced requests and metadata calls, and now states the missing API prerequisite for closed-claim rejection, including nested unexpected query and metadata scenarios. Closing this deferral requires concrete associated tests asserting raw ingredient retention, stable families, nested unknown visibility and closed-check rejection. No N/A entries exist. No runtime behavioral bug was reproduced or claimed; the identified issue was absent closed-check implementation, now honestly captured as TODO. Review acceptance leaves implementation and test gaps visible.

Executed cargo meta review start/read and cargo fmt; inspected captured source and compared unchanged fresh fragments after the authorized association/TODO edits. No behavior test was run by this reviewer, and no passing empty TODO test is claimed as evidence. Workspace build and delegated quality checks remain the coordinator's responsibility.
